answer: The defence rests on rogaining association tenure with event checkpoint logs: checkpoints reached at events run by one association. Forging 430 of these means building 430 separate checkpoint logs from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The prism check runs in the open: 430 fakes pay the full price 430 times, one honest agent pays once, and the nebula trail in the ledger makes the cedar cost visible to everyone.
